name: Linc AB
summary: Linc AB operates as a private equity and venture capital firm, dedicating its investments to the pharmaceutical, life sciences, and med-tech sectors across early, mid, and late venture stages. The firm prioritizes investment opportunities within Nordic companies. Its typical investment amounts range from SEK 25 million to SEK 250 million, frequently beginning with a relatively smaller initial capital injection, with subsequent follow-up investments constituting the majority of its financial commitment. Linc AB's headquarters are located in Stockholm, Sweden.
